harvestIndicators: Pre-flower harvest for peak essential oils
notes: Hardy perennial in zones 5+. Cut hard 2–3× per season.

preserving.note: Herbs in oil can grow Clostridium botulinum. Follow a tested method: keep oil infused with unacidified herbs in the refrigerator and discard it 4 days after making it, or acidify the herbs first exactly as UGA Extension Circular 1334 describes.

careTasks.title: Harvesting can begin just before the plants are ready to flower.
Remove the stem tips leaving 4 to 6 pairs of leaves on the plant in order for it to produce side shoots for additional harvesting.

seasonalTasks.title: Mulch oregano for winter
seasonalTasks.body: In November or December, after the soil has frozen, cover the plants with straw or evergreen boughs. Take it off as growth starts in spring.
